about: Tolmachevo is Novosibirsk’s international airport, named after A. I. Pokryshkin, 17 km west of the city centre. Its time zone is UTC+7: local time is 4 hours ahead of Moscow.

transport.title: Getting there
transport.hint: 111Э and a change at Ob station
transport.text: Express bus 111Э connects the airport with Novosibirsk-Glavny station every 30 minutes: departures from the station run from 05:00 to 00:30, and from the airport from 04:00 to 23:30. If taking a suburban train to Ob station, you need to change for the terminal. Bus 4 calls at the station; the fare is 40 ₽. Buses 111Э and 112 stop at 2-ya Severnaya on Stantsionnaya Street.

lounges.title: Lounges
lounges.text: Domestic business lounges Komfort and Premier on Level 2 of Sector C airside: after security on Level 3 opposite gate No. 6, go down following the signs. The international lounge is on Level 3 of Sector B, 50 seats. In Premier and the international lounge, a paid visit costs 4,000 ₽ for 4 hours, children 2–12 years 2,000 ₽, under 2 free.

storage.title: Left luggage
storage.text: Left luggage for domestic and international passengers is in Sector C and is open round the clock. Baggage 500 ₽ per item per day, outerwear 100 ₽ per day. Storage of less than a day is charged as a full day.

kids.title: With children
kids.text: Mother and child room on Level 3 of Sector C, open round the clock and free. For departing passengers with children under 7, disabled children under 14 and women in the second half of pregnancy. There is a kitchen, a bedroom with cots and a playroom.

parking.title: Parking
parking.text: On the airport terminal forecourt, the first 15 minutes are free, then the first hour costs 400 ₽, the second 300 ₽ and each subsequent hour 200 ₽. Stays longer than 6 hours cost 1,500 ₽ per 24 hours. At car parks P1–P4, the rate per 24 hours is 700 ₽ for stays of up to 3 periods of 24 hours, 500 ₽ for stays of up to 6 such periods, and 300 ₽ for longer stays. Entry is only possible with a recognised licence plate. If you re-enter within 1 hour of leaving, the first 15 minutes cost 100 ₽.
